name: 赤峰街口
why: phase 3 = 赤峰街 green; people cross 南京西路. min_clear = yellow 3 + all-red 3

lamp.why: the 南京西路 lamp at 赤峰街 turns red 2 s before people may cross and stays red through phases 1 and 3

the 南京西路 lamp at 25 巷 turns red at the start of the 7 s all-red that ends phase 1, i.e. 7 s before the pedestrian phase; measured at 10 frames a second the red lasts about 5 s longer than the three phases plus all-red, hence len_extra 12; corrections are allowed here (adjust) because its timing reads as cleanly as the first crossing's, but a wrong lamp duration does not fail the job (not strict) until the duration rule has been seen on every plan

name: 承德路口
full: 承德路一段 × 南京西路
why: two crossings at this junction. 橫越承德路 runs with 南京西路 green: phase 3 in the 4-phase night plans, phase 5 in the 6-phase plans (camera-checked). 橫越南京西路 runs with 承德路 green: phase 1 / phase 2. Measured 2026-11-18 at 10 frames a second: this junction is not fixed from cycle to cycle — the 南京西路 green started 0, 5 or 10 s early and ended up to 5 s early in 7 cycles. So the window is shortened by `shorten` seconds, the page marks it as approximate, and it is left out of the camera check
